name: Detection and Estimation Theory
description: Hypothesis test and Neyman-Pearson lemma, composite hypothesis testing, generalized LRT, sequential and distributed detection, signal detection in continuous time, KL theorem. Bayesian, MMSE and MAP estimation, Fischer-Neyman factorization theorem, Rao-Blackwell theorem, maximum-likelihood estimation, exponential families and the Cramer-Rao bound. Kalman filtering and Weiner filtering. Sequential hypothesis testing in multiple data streams, sequential detection of changes: changepoint models, performance metrics and optimality criteria, Bayesian quickest change detection in a single population.
